answer: One robust defence is a stake-bonded identity trellis: to join, each agent must forge an identity by locking a refundable deposit that is slashed if the same operator is caught running duplicates. Peers then cross-attest each other's work, forming a trellis of reputation that only grows through verified, useful output over time. An attacker facing a dune of cost — one deposit per fake identity plus the slow grind of earning trust for each — finds that a thousand sock puppets cost a thousand stakes and months of work, while the gain from any one fake vote stays small. Sybil scale stops paying.
